definitions.explanation: A woman married to one's father who is not one's biological mother.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同居|どうきょ}→同居：09730_doukyo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{義母|ぎぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother-in-law is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧です。
examples.english: My relationship with my mother-in-law is good.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I was raised by my stepmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くし→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧、{義母|ぎぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I lost my mother at a young age and grew up under the care of my stepmother.

examples.japanese: {義母|ぎぼ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My stepmother was kind to me as if she were my real mother.

notes:
TERMS OF ADDRESS:
While {義母|ぎぼ} is the formal/written term, in conversation people typically address their mother-in-law as:
- ⟦お{義母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ - most common (same pronunciation as the ordinary word for "mother")
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ - explicit "in-law's mother"

USAGE:
{義母|ぎぼ} is more commonly used in:
- Written documents
- Speaking about (not to) one's mother-in-law
- Formal contexts
The ぎ- prefix indicates a family relationship through marriage rather than blood.

FAMILY TERMS WITH THE ぎ- PREFIX:
- ⟦{義父|ぎふ}→義父：06725_gifu⟧ - father-in-law
- ⟦{義兄|ぎけい}→義兄：15784_gikei⟧ - brother-in-law (older)
- ⟦{義弟|ぎてい}→義弟：13981_gitei⟧ - brother-in-law (younger)
- ⟦{義姉|ぎし}→義姉：17835_gishi⟧ - sister-in-law (older)
- ⟦{義妹|ぎまい}→義妹：18404_gimai⟧ - sister-in-law (younger)
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧ - son-in-law
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧ - daughter-in-law
